ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABD) announced a strategic relaunch of its Officer's Choice Blue whisky, featuring new premium packaging and a refreshed brand identity. This initiative aims to elevate the brand's appeal within the Premium & Above segment, cater to evolving consumer tastes, and drive future growth across key Indian markets. The announcement represents a positive brand investment in line with the company's premiumisation strategy, with no apparent red flags.
